options.content:
## 🐦 Bird Home — Prediction Lab
**One-hour-ahead bird activity forecasting** · live forward validation  
Random Forest and XGBoost issue independent forecasts for the same future hour and are scored against observed BirdNET activity.

spec.title: MODEL WIN RATE
spec.description: Percentage of scored hours where each model beats persistence

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
    100.0 * AVG(
        CASE WHEN absolute_error < ABS(current_activity - actual_activity)
             THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END
    ) FILTER (WHERE model = 'random_forest_v2_completed') AS "RF Win Rate",
    100.0 * AVG(
        CASE WHEN absolute_error < ABS(current_activity - actual_activity)
             THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END
    ) FILTER (WHERE model = 'xgboost_v2_completed') AS "XGB Win Rate"
FROM bird_activity_predictions
WHERE actual_activity IS NOT NULL
  AND model IN ('random_forest_v2_completed', 'xgboost_v2_completed');

spec.title: MODEL MAE
spec.description: Average absolute error by live model

spec.title: PERSISTENCE MAE
spec.description: Average error if next hour is assumed to equal the current hour

spec.rawSql:
SELECT AVG(ABS(current_activity - actual_activity)) AS "Persistence MAE"
FROM bird_activity_predictions
WHERE model = 'random_forest_v2_completed'
  AND actual_activity IS NOT NULL;

spec.title: BEST FORECAST ERROR
spec.description: Smallest absolute error recorded by each live model

spec.title: Recent Predictions
spec.description: Head-to-head Random Forest, XGBoost, and persistence comparison for each forecast hour

spec.rawSql:
WITH hourly AS (
    SELECT
        predicted_hour,
        MAX(predicted_activity) FILTER (
            WHERE model = 'random_forest_v2_completed'
        ) AS rf_forecast,
        MAX(predicted_activity) FILTER (
            WHERE model = 'xgboost_v2_completed'
        ) AS xgb_forecast,
        MAX(current_activity) AS persistence,
        MAX(actual_activity) AS actual
    FROM bird_activity_predictions
    WHERE model IN (
        'random_forest_v2_completed',
        'xgboost_v2_completed'
    )
    GROUP BY predicted_hour
)
SELECT
    to_char(predicted_hour, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS "Forecast Hour",
    ROUND(rf_forecast::numeric, 1) AS "Random Forest",
    ROUND(xgb_forecast::numeric, 1) AS "XGBoost",
    ROUND(persistence::numeric, 1) AS "Persistence",
    ROUND(actual::numeric, 1) AS "Actual",
    CASE
        WHEN actual IS NULL THEN NULL
        ELSE ROUND(ABS(rf_forecast - actual)::numeric, 1)
    END AS "RF Error",
    CASE
        WHEN actual IS NULL OR xgb_forecast IS NULL THEN NULL
        ELSE ROUND(ABS(xgb_forecast - actual)::numeric, 1)
    END AS "XGB Error",
    CASE
        WHEN actual IS NULL THEN NULL
        ELSE ROUND(ABS(persistence - actual)::numeric, 1)
    END AS "Persistence Error",
    CASE
        WHEN actual IS NULL THEN 'PENDING'
        WHEN xgb_forecast IS NULL THEN
            CASE
                WHEN ABS(rf_forecast - actual) < ABS(persistence - actual)
                    THEN 'RF BEST'
                WHEN ABS(rf_forecast - actual) > ABS(persistence - actual)
                    THEN 'PERSISTENCE BEST'
                ELSE 'TIE'
            END
        WHEN ABS(rf_forecast - actual) < ABS(xgb_forecast - actual)
         AND ABS(rf_forecast - actual) < ABS(persistence - actual)
            THEN 'RF BEST'
        WHEN ABS(xgb_forecast - actual) < ABS(rf_forecast - actual)
         AND ABS(xgb_forecast - actual) < ABS(persistence - actual)
            THEN 'XGB BEST'
        WHEN ABS(persistence - actual) < ABS(rf_forecast - actual)
         AND ABS(persistence - actual) < ABS(xgb_forecast - actual)
            THEN 'PERSISTENCE BEST'
        ELSE 'TIE'
    END AS "Best"
FROM hourly
ORDER BY predicted_hour DESC
LIMIT 50;

options.content:
### 🧪 Reading the Prediction Lab
**Blue** = Random Forest · **Purple** = XGBoost · **Green** = observed activity · **Orange** = persistence  
Both ML models predict the same future hour independently. The useful model is the one that produces **lower forward error consistently over time**.

spec.title: NEXT HOUR FORECAST
spec.description: Latest Random Forest and XGBoost forecasts for the same target hour

spec.rawSql: SELECT activity_index AS "Activity" FROM bird_activity_hourly ORDER BY hour_local DESC LIMIT 1;

spec.title: LIVE MODEL MAE
spec.description: Mean absolute error of scored forward predictions. Lower is better.

spec.title: MODEL EDGE
spec.description: Percentage MAE improvement versus persistence. Positive is better.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN AVG(ABS(current_activity - actual_activity))
             FILTER (WHERE model = 'random_forest_v2_completed') = 0
        THEN NULL
        ELSE 100.0 * (
            AVG(ABS(current_activity - actual_activity))
                FILTER (WHERE model = 'random_forest_v2_completed')
            -
            AVG(absolute_error)
                FILTER (WHERE model = 'random_forest_v2_completed')
        ) /
        AVG(ABS(current_activity - actual_activity))
            FILTER (WHERE model = 'random_forest_v2_completed')
    END AS "RF Edge",
    CASE
        WHEN AVG(ABS(current_activity - actual_activity))
             FILTER (WHERE model = 'xgboost_v2_completed') = 0
        THEN NULL
        ELSE 100.0 * (
            AVG(ABS(current_activity - actual_activity))
                FILTER (WHERE model = 'xgboost_v2_completed')
            -
            AVG(absolute_error)
                FILTER (WHERE model = 'xgboost_v2_completed')
        ) /
        AVG(ABS(current_activity - actual_activity))
            FILTER (WHERE model = 'xgboost_v2_completed')
    END AS "XGB Edge"
FROM bird_activity_predictions
WHERE actual_activity IS NOT NULL
  AND model IN ('random_forest_v2_completed', 'xgboost_v2_completed');

spec.title: SCORED HOURS
spec.description: Distinct forecast target hours with known outcomes

spec.rawSql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT predicted_hour) AS "Scored"
FROM bird_activity_predictions
WHERE actual_activity IS NOT NULL
  AND model IN ('random_forest_v2_completed', 'xgboost_v2_completed');

spec.title: Forecast vs Reality
spec.description: Random Forest and XGBoost forward forecasts compared with observed activity and persistence

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  predicted_hour AT TIME ZONE 'America/Los_Angeles' AS "time",
  predicted_activity AS "Random Forest"
FROM bird_activity_predictions
WHERE model = 'random_forest_v2_completed'
  AND $__timeFilter(predicted_hour AT TIME ZONE 'America/Los_Angeles')
ORDER BY predicted_hour;

SELECT
  predicted_hour AT TIME ZONE 'America/Los_Angeles' AS "time",
  predicted_activity AS "XGBoost"
FROM bird_activity_predictions
WHERE model = 'xgboost_v2_completed'
  AND $__timeFilter(predicted_hour AT TIME ZONE 'America/Los_Angeles')
ORDER BY predicted_hour;

SELECT
  predicted_hour AT TIME ZONE 'America/Los_Angeles' AS "time",
  actual_activity AS "Actual Activity"
FROM bird_activity_predictions
WHERE model = 'random_forest_v2_completed'
  AND actual_activity IS NOT NULL
  AND $__timeFilter(predicted_hour AT TIME ZONE 'America/Los_Angeles')
ORDER BY predicted_hour;

SELECT
  predicted_hour AT TIME ZONE 'America/Los_Angeles' AS "time",
  current_activity AS "Persistence"
FROM bird_activity_predictions
WHERE model = 'random_forest_v2_completed'
  AND $__timeFilter(predicted_hour AT TIME ZONE 'America/Los_Angeles')
ORDER BY predicted_hour;

spec.title: Prediction Error
spec.description: Absolute error for Random Forest, XGBoost, and persistence.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  predicted_hour AT TIME ZONE 'America/Los_Angeles' AS "time",
  absolute_error AS "RF Error"
FROM bird_activity_predictions
WHERE model = 'random_forest_v2_completed'
  AND actual_activity IS NOT NULL
  AND $__timeFilter(predicted_hour AT TIME ZONE 'America/Los_Angeles')
ORDER BY predicted_hour;

SELECT
  predicted_hour AT TIME ZONE 'America/Los_Angeles' AS "time",
  absolute_error AS "XGB Error"
FROM bird_activity_predictions
WHERE model = 'xgboost_v2_completed'
  AND actual_activity IS NOT NULL
  AND $__timeFilter(predicted_hour AT TIME ZONE 'America/Los_Angeles')
ORDER BY predicted_hour;

SELECT
  predicted_hour AT TIME ZONE 'America/Los_Angeles' AS "time",
  ABS(current_activity - actual_activity) AS "Persistence Error"
FROM bird_activity_predictions
WHERE model = 'random_forest_v2_completed'
  AND actual_activity IS NOT NULL
  AND $__timeFilter(predicted_hour AT TIME ZONE 'America/Los_Angeles')
ORDER BY predicted_hour;

spec.title: Daily MAE — RF vs XGBoost vs Persistence
spec.description: Daily average absolute error by model.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  date_trunc('day', predicted_hour) AT TIME ZONE 'America/Los_Angeles' AS "time",
  AVG(absolute_error) AS "RF MAE"
FROM bird_activity_predictions
WHERE model = 'random_forest_v2_completed'
  AND actual_activity IS NOT NULL
  AND $__timeFilter(predicted_hour AT TIME ZONE 'America/Los_Angeles')
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1;

SELECT
  date_trunc('day', predicted_hour) AT TIME ZONE 'America/Los_Angeles' AS "time",
  AVG(absolute_error) AS "XGB MAE"
FROM bird_activity_predictions
WHERE model = 'xgboost_v2_completed'
  AND actual_activity IS NOT NULL
  AND $__timeFilter(predicted_hour AT TIME ZONE 'America/Los_Angeles')
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1;

SELECT
  date_trunc('day', predicted_hour) AT TIME ZONE 'America/Los_Angeles' AS "time",
  AVG(ABS(current_activity - actual_activity)) AS "Persistence MAE"
FROM bird_activity_predictions
WHERE model = 'random_forest_v2_completed'
  AND actual_activity IS NOT NULL
  AND $__timeFilter(predicted_hour AT TIME ZONE 'America/Los_Angeles')
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1;
